title: Battlefield Bad Company Xbox 360, EA - With Manual, Very Good
descriptionText:
Immerse yourself in the explosive action and intense gameplay of Battlefield: Bad Company on the Xbox 360. This first-person shooter game, released in 2008 by Electronic Arts, is rated T for Teen and features a thrilling storyline set in a fictional world. With NTSC-U/C (US/CA) region code, this game provides an adrenaline-pumping experience for fans of the shooter genre.

Included in this package is a manual, providing detailed information on the game's features and controls. The game's publisher, Electronic Arts, has ensured that this title meets the highest standards of quality and entertainment. Get ready to engage in epic battles and strategic warfare with Battlefield: Bad Company on the Xbox 360.
